Original comment posted Oct 27 2024, AFTER the official Oct 25 2024 prospecting gem/byproduct hotfix (Blizzard running list: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24148555/hotfixes-october-28-2024); original data collection window is UNSTATED, so do not assign observed means to the post-hotfix epoch solely from post date. Author says 'averages per 200 ore after doing 400 of each (rank 1 or rank 2)'; the rank mixture, completed casts, refund handling, specialization and per-cast hits are unknown. The original reported per-200-input value is converted arithmetically to per-1000-input averageShown, not to drop probability. Do not assign an exact rank-specific input item ID or interpret this as a current post-hotfix baseline. Source reports 12 Glittering Glass per 200 Bismuth ore, equivalent to 60 per 1000 input ore; the '400 of each' may include both ranks.
